name: Scouting Cartridge
body:
Source Ranged Tactics Toolbox pg. 25
Aura faint divination CL 5th
Slot none; Price 566 gp ; Weight —
Description
This +1 paper alchemical cartridge is contains a bullet and is marked with an open eye. When fired from a firearm, a scouting cartridge allows the wielder to temporarily transfer his sense of sight to the location where the bullet lands. Until he dismisses the effect by rubbing his eyes as a move action, the wielder can see as clairvoyance from the square in which the bullet landed, regardless of whether it hit its mark.
Construction
Requirements Craft Magic Arms and Armor, clairaudience/clairvoyance; Price 286 gp
